description: Recommendation thresholds for the offline facial-gate variant comparison harness (tools/experiments/facial_gate_experiment.py). This file controls the labeling of recommendation verdicts (KEEP_BINARY / TRY_LOOSER_BINARY / EXPERIMENT_TERNARY_ONLY / NOT_ENOUGH_DATA / INVESTIGATE_REGRESSION). It does NOT move the production gate. Editing this file does not affect shared/judgment/templates.py:FACIAL_TRIAGE_TEMPLATE, parse_facial_response, or any production decision contract.
